# Flagship PP distance 24

This package retains the ordinary CSS distance certificate for
[[1024,256,24]] with check weight 11 and optimum frame width 25. It is separate
from the detector-targeted width exclusion in [pp_width](../pp_width/README.md).

Run `python3 verification/pp_distance/check.py` from the folder root. The checker
verifies the physical checks and ranks, the weight 24 nontrivial logical, the
sector-reflection isometry, and all 64 completed hash-prefix shards through
weight 23, including source/input binding, terminal logs and common frontier
coverage. It does not rerun the deep search or check every pruned node.

The original C++17 source, physical matrices, manifests and completed records
are in records/. To compile a fresh engine and replay shard 0:

```sh
c++ -O3 -std=c++17 verification/pp_distance/records/exact.cpp -o /tmp/pp-distance
/tmp/pp-distance verification/pp_distance/records/search.mat 64 23 86400 --shard 0 64 6 18446744073709551615
```

All shards 0 through63 must complete, using the same input and settings, before
a fresh lower bound is established. A found witness or incomplete shard does
not certify exclusion. The non-CSS reverse-folded companion study is not part
of this public package.

Public receipts have calendar, job, and workstation metadata removed. File hashes
bind the normalized copies. Executable fingerprints are declarations; compiled
binaries are omitted. Portable replay builds from the supplied source.
